messages:
Marta: Heads-up — starting rolling release from eu-west -> us-east in ~10m. We'll pin model v2.3.2 and migrate 30% traffic to the new variant as a canary. Watch SLOs (p95 / 5xx) and KV cache latency. I'll post the deploy link.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release_id=rel_2026_03_21_01, step=canary, targets=eu-west->us-east, traffic=30%. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/rel_2026_03_21_01 :rocket:

Sahil: I'll watch p95 and error budget. If p95 > 350ms or 5xx rate > 0.7% for 3 consecutive minutes, we pause and rollback. :eyes:

Noah: Added a short smoke check to preflight: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"short"}' | jq '.latency'` — will loop every 30s from us-east.

Marta: Ops-oncall — if we see a KVcache hot-spot, please trigger `ops rollback` and pin traffic to v2.3.1. I'll sign off on rollback after confirmation.

Ops-oncall: Copy. I'll watch the dashboard and enable alertset `deploy-runway-early-warning`. Will post updates and escalate if >3 alerts in 5m.

Sahil: Quick question — what's the fallback plan for the embeddings route? We had a routing mismatch last quarter.

Marta: Plan: embeddings -> fallback replica in us-west with model v2.2.9; we route embedding-heavy requests there if 429s spike. Also enabling `circuit-breaker: true` in routing policy.

Noah: Preflight snapshot: CPU/GPU util — eu-west 42%/65%, us-east 38%/60%. KVcache miss p95 18ms. Rolling in 5m.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 5% -> 15% -> 30% (canary). Monitors: p95, 5xx, kvcache_miss. Alerts: none so far. :white_check_mark:

Sahil: Seeing a minor p95 bump to 180ms (baseline ~120ms), not alarming yet. I'll dig into traces if it crosses 250ms.

Marta: If we get any spike to >350ms or 5xx >0.7% I'll call rollback. Everyone ready?

Ops-oncall: Ready. Annotating the incident runbook with the rollout id.

Noah: Smoke tests green. No errors from synthetic requests in staging.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 30% traffic. No deploy alerts. Proceeding to ramp to 60% in 3m unless someone requests a stop.

Sahil: Ack, continuing active watch.

Marta: Ramp to 60% now. Keep an eye on embeddings route and kvcache.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 60% complete. Monitoring window: 10m.

Ops-oncall: Alert: 5xx rate on `embeddings_route` up to 0.9% over 2m — investigating. :exclamation:

Sahil: Pulling traces — looks like marshalling timeout on embedding worker pool, leading to 500s. Initiating partial traffic pin to fallback us-west for embeddings with `route.pin(embeddings, us-west, 70%)`.

Marta: Do it. Also enable `circuit-breaker` for embeddings and reduce batch size from 64 -> 32 on the new variant.

Noah: Command run: `route.pin embeddings us-west 70%` — confirmed. Updated canary config: batch_size=32.

deploy-bot: Traffic pin applied. Embedding 5xx dropped to 0.2% within ~40s. Monitoring continues.

Ops-oncall: Marking mitigated. Holding deployment at 60% for remaining checks. Will block final ramp until green for 10m.

Marta: Agree. Holding final ramp. Nice quick mitigation, team. :clap:

Sahil: I'll follow up with a short postmortem note — root looks like tail latency from batch size 64 + KV cache misses causing marshalling timeouts.

Marta: Thanks. After the 10m green window we'll finish ramp. If anything else shows up we'll rollback to v2.3.1.

Ops-oncall: Update: 10m green window passed. No further alerts. Ready to finish roll.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic on v2.3.2. Release rel_2026_03_21_01 succeeded. :tada:

Marta: Added notes to release channel and will draft release notes highlighting the embedding fallback and the KVcache observation. Postmortem to follow if needed.

Sahil: Thanks all. Smooth coordinated run.
